import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
import wire
def run(case):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/solver.py'],
                       input=json.dumps({'cases': [case]}).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:300]
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['cases'][0]

case = {'primitive': 'allgather', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1, 'capacity': 1,
        'start': 7, 'trace': 32,
        'events': [{'op': 'data', 'rank': r, 'p': 0, 'values': [100 + r]} for r in range(4)]}
out = run(case)
print('packets', out['packets'])
frames = [(t['rank'], bytes.fromhex(t['hex'])) for t in out['trace']]
for rank, raw in frames:
    bth = raw[42:54]
    psn = int.from_bytes(bth[9:12], 'big')
    print('  dest=%d op=%s q=%d payload=%s' % (rank, hex(bth[0]), psn - 7,
                                               int.from_bytes(raw[54:58], 'big') if bth[0] == 4 else None))
want = []
for d in range(4):
    for s in [r for r in range(4) if r != d]:
        want.append((d, 3 * 0 + [r for r in range(4) if r != d].index(s), 100 + s))
print('expected (dest,q,word):', want)
got = [(rank, int.from_bytes(raw[42:54][9:12], 'big') - 7, int.from_bytes(raw[54:58], 'big'))
       for rank, raw in frames if raw[42] == 4]
print('MATCH' if sorted(got) == sorted(want) else 'MISMATCH', got)
PY
